title: System Design
description: Design systems that stay fast, correct, and available, following Designing Data-Intensive Applications. Start with the foundations (networks, operating systems, APIs, and databases), then go from one server to load balancers, caches, replication, partitioning, transactions, consensus, message queues, and streams, and learn to see inside it all with metrics, logs, and traces. Estimate load, stress architectures in the traffic simulator, and build a storage engine, a consistent-hash partitioner, and Raft in Python. Ends with a capstone: design a Twitter timeline that survives spikes, partitions, and crashes.
author: FreeKnowledge contributors
